rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose collective word for everybody.

example.english: Everybody come to work a bit earlier tomorrow.
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 ting1 jat6 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this when you want to state explicitly that all people are included.

example.english: Everybody has to wear a mask.
example.jyutping: so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 jiu3 daai3 hau2 zaau3

rows.note: Use this when stressing each individual person rather than the group collectively.

example.jyutping: go3 go3 dou1 waa6 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this when addressing everybody in a group, especially politely or publicly.
